scope: construction/rendering only, no full page/pixel/UIA promotion

checks: Every recorded PNG had at least one nonconstant RGB channel.
Frame hashes were distinct within each run.
Logged frame IDs matched every output directory exactly.
Retained PNG bytes equal their original capture files.
The five historical PNGs equal their existing committed bytes.
validation.visual_review: The eight retained current frames were inspected for construction/layout/rendering. Rating stars and some icons show missing Segoe glyph boxes on this host.
limitations: No full-page, upstream Windows pixel-parity or platform UIA acceptance is established.
Static ProgressRing frames do not verify animation motion.
CompactSizing frames show the initial Standard selection; rendered compact-state switching and field retention are not established by these frames.
Pending pages render the source browser; their platform controls are not instantiated.
The four retained light images come from the separate selected_light run; its hashes need not equal the corresponding all_light frames.

source_hash_scope: All Gallery runtime Rust/XAML files; WinUI namespace controls and opt-in migration files; WinUI theme Rust/XAML/build inputs; selected registration/dependency inputs. Test fixtures and documentation are excluded. The compiled theme build outputs identify production generated files, not the checked-in reference pointer.
retention: Only the eight current and five historical PNGs are checked in here. Remaining sweep PNGs, executable, archive and run logs are temporary artifacts identified by their hashes.
